name: eqemu-oracle
description: Deterministic EQEmu context plus guarded remote server file staging and undo for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: EQEmu context plus guarded remote file staging
interface.longDescription: Bring deterministic EQEmu context into Codex through local staged snapshots, extension overlays, a built-in MCP server for Perl and Lua quest API lookup, MySQL schema lookup, official documentation lookup, and optional guarded FTP/FTPS staging for remote server files with local restore points and undo.
defaultPrompt: Use EQEmu Oracle to explain this Perl or Lua quest API call
Use EQEmu Oracle to find the schema and relationships for this EQEmu table
Use EQEmu Oracle to locate the official EQEmu documentation page for this topic
Use EQEmu Oracle to stage a remote EQEmu server file for review
